Distribution family and member: DFAM $\distfam$, DFAMSUB $\distfamof{\text{lin}}^2$, DMEM $\distmem$, DMEMSUB $\distmemof{\theta}^2$.

Fitted distribution model: EDMEM $\edistmem$, EDMEMSUB $\edistmemof{\trainset}^2$.

Prediction family: PFAM $\predfam$, PFAMSUB $\predfamof{\text{lin}}^2$.

Mean-function component: MEANSUB $\meanfnof{\distmem}^2$, MEANAPP $\meanfnoff{\edistmem}{\predvar}^2$, MEANTRUE $\meanfnoff{\popdist}{\predvar}$, MEANTALL $\meanfnof{\frac{a}{b}}$.
